title: The weighted image of a bi-Lipschitz parameter piece under a Lipschitz map is an integer multiplicity current with the expected mass bound (Simon 6.3.5–3.9 on one injective piece; step 7 of the selected proof)
statement: Assume (IMC), the exact frozen statement of the accepted DAG theorem cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub (tangent locality; restriction of an IMRep to a Borel set represents a current; differences of IM currents are IM; |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e. for IMReps). Let k, N' ∈ ℕ, H : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{N'} L-Lipschitz, A ⊆ ℝᵏ Borel, κ > 0 with κ|a − a'| ≤ |H(a) − H(a')| for a, a' ∈ A, H differentiable with injective derivative at every point of A, and g : ℝᵏ → ℝ Borel, integer-valued at every point and nonzero at every point of A, with ∫⁻_A |g|·J_H dLᵏ < ∞ (J_H(u) := (det[⟨DH(u)e_a, DH(u)e_b⟩])^{1/2}, e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1). Then there is an integer multiplicity current Φ ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k) with M(Φ) ≤ ∫⁻_A |g|·J_H dLᵏ and Φ(ω) = ∫_A g(u)·ω(H(u))(DH(u)e_0, …, DH(u)e_{k−1}) du for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}).
